content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity).**

The duplicate § 12.4 (p0046) imposes a non-compete on us that breaches the walk-away line on three counts: a 24-month post-term tail, unlimited territory, and undefined scope ("any product or service that competes with Vendor"), extending even to acquisitions and internal development. It is also internally inconsistent with § 12.3 (p0044), in which Vendor expressly acknowledges that we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.

Redline: delete p0046 outright (validated, ok:true), with a comment noting the § 12.3 conflict and offering the narrowed fallback — a single named competing product, term only, with carve-outs for internal development and acquisitions — if Vendor claims a genuine protection need.
